title: Conditional κ = 7.44714499357628·10⁻⁴: 450 collective response-kernel entries on #285's gen5 word, after #287's descent and target squares (+0.080% over #287)
body:
# Conditional κ = 7.44714499357628·10⁻⁴: 450 collective response-kernel entries on #285's gen5 word, after #287's descent and target squares (+0.080% over #287)

One self-contained package, `research/five-stage-gen5-collective-kernels/` (#287's package with one added stage), with its own workflow. No existing file is changed.

**κ = 186178624839407/(25·10¹⁶) = 7.44714499357628·10⁻⁴**, +5.94·10⁻⁷ over #287's 7.44120696397042·10⁻⁴ and +0.259% over #285's gen5 word; the bit side binds (bit coarse 7.45270·10⁻⁴, complex 7.47455·10⁻⁴).

## Result

The collective response-kernel stage of #282 (gen4) and #284 (on #283), re-derived on gen5 and inserted after #287's two stages: **450 entries with per-entry cuts** — 260 twin pairs (244 on a line, 16 on a rank-3 entrance) and 190 multi-donor families (151 quadruples, 39 triples): the pivot's complete F₂ target response is the XOR of its donors', all members share a nondegenerate common entrance of dimension 1–18 inside their first required frames, 33 donors serve several entries along nested chains. The pivot's compensation reads are deleted, it enters at the common entrance, each donor pays its shear there after the cut and the inverse at the full frame.

| one invocation, m = 120 | #285 | #287 | this package |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| entrances | 2,554 | 2,554 | **3,004** |
| literal stock, 60 replicas | 1,247,070 | 1,247,070 | **1,244,515** |
| bit coarse saving | 7.43338·10⁻⁴ | — | **7.45270·10⁻⁴** |
| κ | 7.42785663120535·10⁻⁴ | 7.44120696397042·10⁻⁴ | **7.44714499357628·10⁻⁴** |

**Census on gen5** (after #287's stages): 13,332 plain dirty helpers, every compensation read before the helper's first other use (gap ≥ 41,240 records), so each entry gets its own cut, bound by content; responses of F₂ rank 1,760 (nullity 11,572); 1,220 twin classes; low-weight response circuits 2,402 triangles and 20,003 quadruples at class level; with a common cut and a nondegenerate common entrance: 292 pairs, 276 triples, 1,103 quadruples. Greedy packing under the deficit-fixed φ ledger (φ(r) = r·ln(120/r)) keeps 450 (entrance rank 1,022); the model reproduces #287's κ exactly and predicted this κ exactly. The members are plain dirty helpers, disjoint from the targets whose reads #287's squares delete and from its retimed source-pair mixes.

## Checks

`kernel_transform.replay` runs all 19,406 formal columns forward and inverse on the emitted word, rejects both omitted-gate controls (2,405 / 757 wrong rows) and checks the prefix relation for every entry; then every stage of #287's verifier runs fresh — virtual, raw, bit (with #287's descent and target stages), scalar, primes (545 charts ≤ 576 factors, normalizer bound 815), banks (pivot residual widths tiled by (r⁴, 4³⁰⁻ʳ) banks on top of gen5's own patterns, every bank width 120 and full; selector calls 932,937,188,400 < 2⁴⁰), complex, math, finite — with ten omitted-stage negative controls; the geometry stage samples an actual entrance basis for every rank present. Every #287 literal the rewrite changes is a recomputed pinned value in `expected/kernel-pins.json`, asserted by `pins.pin`; none is dropped (`KERNEL-PROOF.md` lists them).

## Verify

    python -m pip install -r research/five-stage-gen5-collective-kernels/requirements.txt    # sympy 1.14.0
    python3 -B research/five-stage-gen5-collective-kernels/verify.py --output /tmp/gen5-collective-kernels-verification   # about 4 minutes; not under -I

Prints `PASS_IMMUTABLE_GEN5_KERNEL_ENTRIES_FIVE_STAGE_BANKED_CONSTRUCTION` with κ. The workflow runs it and #285's generator check on Ubuntu (Python 3.11, 3.13).

## Scope and limits

* Conditional finite construction under the retained public all-size hypotheses (no Lean certificate). #285 and #287 are open; their word and stages are inherited unchanged, not re-proved.
* The bit side is now 0.29% below the complex supplier (#193's word, 7.47455·10⁻⁴ in the five-stage layout). #233's complex word gives 7.547·10⁻⁴ in that layout (Lean-checked through #256 and jacobalansussman/wht-power-saving-lean#2); its gcert/1 certificate is a drop-in for this package's complex stage (verified separately, κ unchanged while the bit side binds) and will matter once bit-side gains exceed the margin.
* Not exploited: pivots of residual width 3 or 4; quintuple families (never net-positive under φ); the 928 twin pairs whose first frames do not intersect.

## Credits

Prepared by Chafik Boukhalfa with substantial Anthropic Claude assistance. Apache-2.0; lineage in `NOTICE.md`. The gen5 word and its package are DreamingOfClouds' (#285, on #276); the descent and target-square stages and the package this extends are rohanarun's (#287); the target-prefix mechanism and the kernel-stage form are eumemic's (#268, on the source527 lineage); the response-kernel mechanism, collective kernels and the tiling rule are Dugongue's (#254/#259/#272/#283); the five-stage layout is hcg890's (#234) with Jacob Sussman's construction. This package contributes the gen5 censuses, the 450-entry selection, the generalised stage on gen5, the tiling, the re-pinned checks and the discovery scripts.
